items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Bonnie Begott went on up and started playing with Lewis Armstrong.

ctx.x: Yeah, okay. I have a job tonight. Yeah. We were talking about Bonnie Begott. Yeah, I was. Could he play then? Was he just, he was just learning?
Oh, Bonnie Begott. Yeah. Yeah, Bonnie Begott could play, because he had learned on the T.O. And then after here, Bonnie Begott went on up and started playing with Lewis Armstrong.
Oh, yeah. What instrument was he playing then, mainly?
